scope: Thread destinations now resolve in the single-chat shell and overlay without pretending their channel type is text. Their governing permission source is exactly one same-server text parent, matching server inheritance rules.

Thread metadata is account/login-generation/server scoped. List/detail requests carry expected owner and current-context guards; late account, delete, parent-delete, archive and list/detail responses are fenced. Thread WS events use the original live-connection predicate.

The authenticated GET /api/servers/{serverId}/threads/{threadId} endpoint validates thread/server, a real same-server text parent and current parent read permission, allowing archived reads but no unauthorized metadata disclosure.

Main-shell reload/deep-link and repeated-navigation paths force detail revalidation instead of relying on ephemeral cache. Reconnection refreshes the current known thread before reusing compose capability. Loading/failed metadata does not authorize native projection.

Preview/history may remain available for archived threads; compose additionally requires unarchived metadata and parent SendMessages. Sends still target the actual thread ID through the existing E2EE-aware path. Nested-thread UI/actions are suppressed for known non-text parents.
No migration or user database modification was needed for this additive API/client slice.
